title: AortaCFD: Patient-Specific Aortic Blood Flow Simulation
description: An end-to-end automated pipeline for patient-specific cardiovascular CFD using OpenFOAM 12. Streamlines the complete workflow from STL geometry + flow waveform to hemodynamic outputs (TAWSS, OSI, RRT), with composable configuration, three numerics profiles (robust/standard/precise), per-outlet boundary condition types (Windkessel, fixedValue, zeroGradient), and Windkessel coefficients computed via Murray's law.
